description: GHOST TOMS: low, mid and high toms on one engine, each with its own tune, decay, level, trigger and output

params.text: Sets the pitch of the low tom
Sets how long the low tom rings
Sets the low tom's output level
Sets the pitch of the mid tom
Sets how long the mid tom rings
Sets the mid tom's output level
Sets the pitch of the high tom
Sets how long the high tom rings
Sets the high tom's output level

inputs.text: Fires the low tom on a rise past 2V, and samples both accent jacks at that instant
Fires the mid tom on a rise past 2V, and samples both accent jacks at that instant
Fires the high tom on a rise past 2V, and samples both accent jacks at that instant
Raises the level and the accent character of a hit on any of the three toms while it is high at the moment of its trigger, as Accent B
Raises the level and the accent character of a hit on any of the three toms while it is high at the moment of its trigger, as Accent A, shared by the whole kit
Adds to the low tune knob, the whole knob range over 10V
Adds to the low decay knob, the whole knob range over 10V
Adds to the low level knob, the whole knob range over 10V
Adds to the mid tune knob, the whole knob range over 10V
Adds to the mid decay knob, the whole knob range over 10V
Adds to the mid level knob, the whole knob range over 10V
Adds to the high tune knob, the whole knob range over 10V
Adds to the high decay knob, the whole knob range over 10V
Adds to the high level knob, the whole knob range over 10V

notes: the total accent jack reads as accented while nothing is patched into it, so a voice on its own sounds at its accented level until you patch an accent gate
the accent amounts and master level come from a GHOST CTRL touching this module, or reaching it along a row of touching Ghost modules; with no controller the voice runs at its own settings
